observations.observation: The adopted predecessor D-312 closes its eligibility sentence with 'D-056 Eligibility gates 2 and 3 do not hold for DR-103. Gate 1 Class A is not opened. Not eligible in kind. Not SATISFIED.' D-313 writes 'D-056 Eligibility gates 2 and 3 do not hold as a new SATISFIED recording of this join. Gate 1 Class A is not opened.' and drops both 'Not eligible in kind' and 'Not SATISFIED'.
observations.whyItDoesNotStand: The deviation is required, not a defect. DR-104 is SATISFIED at file 08 line 286 under D-056 Class B (D-236). Carrying D-312's unqualified 'Not SATISFIED' into a DR-104 entry would state a falsehood about the live row and would read as an attempt to unwrite D-236. Re-aiming the gate sentence at 'a new SATISFIED recording of this join' scopes it to the act rather than the row, which is the only formulation consistent with both D-236 and the D-293 A3 instruction to carry the token verbatim. The dropped substance is preserved elsewhere: line 12 'Not SATISFIED-GRADE', line 14 'Does not mark any row SATISFIED', line 15 'Does not SATISFY DR-104'.

observations.where: Title and Subject, warrant version number
observations.observation: D-293 A3's agreed text says 'REMASURE identity-namespace leftover-join.v6 to v7 as a bookkeeping successor', naming v7. The successor actually recorded here is v8, and the draft still calls it 'the D-293 A3 bookkeeping successor'.
observations.whyItDoesNotStand: A3's operative content is the four properties (i) through (iv), not the integer. The v7 attempt was drafted, dual-REJECTed (Claude REJECT with CLAUDE-INLJ-V7-MF1 and CLAUDE-INLJ-V7-SF1; Codex REJECT with two unlabeled SHOULD-FIX), and frozen CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED without recording. v8 lands all four A3 properties and both v7 findings, and the draft states plainly that v7 is not recorded as current. Reading A3's projected version integer as binding would leave the warrant unusable after any REJECT, which is not how any prior lineage in this corpus behaves.

observations.observation: Those two sentences follow immediately after a sentence whose grammatical subject is identity-namespace leftover-join.v6, so a reader could attach the status to v6 rather than to the v8 subject of the section.
observations.whyItDoesNotStand: The placement is byte-for-byte the adopted house pattern: the D-312 draft ends its Subject with the identical trailer in the identical position, immediately after its v12 currency sentence, and was adopted with dual CONSENT. Both readings are also true on the bytes - v8, v7 and v6 all carry status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and binds NOTHING - so no reading of the sentence produces a false claim.

observations.observation: The frozen v8's doesNot writes 'Does not unwrite D-167 through D-174, D-175, D-208, D-236, or D-312.' The draft's Reversibility line writes 'Does not unwrite D-012, D-056, D-167, D-175, D-208, D-236, D-293, or D-312', collapsing the D-167 through D-174 span to D-167 alone while adding D-012, D-056 and D-293.
observations.whyItDoesNotStand: A COORD entry's reversibility list is the entry's own curated list, not a mirror of the artifact's clause; the same divergence was raised and refuted against the adopted D-312. The list is a set of things the decision does not unwrite, so a shorter list unwrites nothing extra - the draft makes no positive claim about D-168 through D-174 at all. D-167 is the operative recording for this lineage (it made DR-G31 live), and the three additions are the policy, class and warrant decisions the Decision section actually leans on.

observations.observation: The G31 specification lineage is written 'G31 occupancy v5' on first mention but bare 'occupancy v2' on the following sentence, in both sections.
observations.whyItDoesNotStand: The stem 'occupancy' is present in both, which is what separates this lineage from the leftover-join lineage; no bare 'v2' appears. The identical bare form is used by the coordinator's own live-state statement in the review prompt, by the frozen v8's basedOn.occupancyV5.role and remeasurementClause, and by D-208's framing. The corpus rule under attack targets unstemmed leftover-join version tokens, and none appears in this draft.
